scenarios.scenario: Retain the last selected template after an application restart

background_steps.name: a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-generic-candidate.opj` as its active project
its Metric folder contains a standard part template with the material label Generic

scenario_steps.name: fixture `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with Sketch1 visible in the MCAD Software
the user presses Control+N
the Create New File chooser opens over the part
the user selects the metric template folder
the user selects the standard metric part template in the Part group
the user cancels the chooser
the user closes the MCAD Software while the part remains unchanged
the user restarts the MCAD Software
the user opens fixture `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd`
the user presses Control+N
the Create New File chooser opens over the part
the template gallery is grouped by document type
Metric is selected in the template folder tree
the standard metric part template is selected in the Part group
the details identify a Part with millimeter units and Generic material
Create and Cancel are available
the existing part and sketch remain visible behind the chooser
the user presses Escape
the chooser closes without creating a document
the same part and sketch remain active
